searchText: **EOF Implementers Call #42** Meeting Info: Apr 17, 2024, 15:00 UTC Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1014 Join Zoom Meeting: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88940506383?pwd=aTdsbHVyMTNDSUFHYmhTWlI2ZEVldz09 <@360491619402776577> evmone has some EOF validation unit tests with hand-written bytecodes: https://github.com/ethereum/evmone/blob/master/test/unittests/eof_validation_test.cpp <@403707149043105803> https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/86 <@360491619402776577> Here are the validation tests Besu is running against: https://github.com/ethereum/tests/tree/develop/EOFTests, in particular efValidation and efStack. I'm researching some issues in the EIP4200, EIP4750, EIP5450, and efExample directories. At some point some of them were against the old spec so I had excluded them. They all appear valid now. **EOF Implementers Meeting 42 [April 17, 2024]** https://youtu.be/gGGiJimhu9Y I stumbled upon the 0x80 non-returning special case for section 0. In our code it was not allowed to have outputs > 127, looks like this changed from the shanghai spec to now, just fyi for anyone implementing Yea, I had to re-write all my tests for that change, at least to change the type data in section zero for all hand built EOF cases I had.
